title: Simulate magnetization plateaus
action: Implement the Ising model Hamiltonian (Eq. 1) with antiferromagnetic Mn-Mn coupling and ferromagnetic Nd-Nd coupling, using dimensionless parameters. Perform Monte Carlo simulations with the heat bath algorithm on an L=32 lattice at t=1.2, R2=-4.2, He=0, for R1=0.5 and R1=5.0. Sweep the reduced crystal field d_s over a range covering the plateau regions (e.g., -80 to 0) with sufficient resolution. Record the sublattice magnetizations M_Mn+ and M_Mn- at each d_s.
description: Raw magnetization data showing the plateau structure of the Mn sublattice.
output_schema: Columns: R1 (float), d_s (float), M_Mn_plus (float), M_Mn_minus (float). Rows sorted by R1 then d_s.

title: Determine critical crystal fields
action: From the magnetization vs d_s data, identify the three first-order transition points where the sublattice magnetizations jump, for R1=0.5 and R1=5.0. Output the critical d_s values.
description: Critical crystal fields at which first-order transitions occur in the Mn sublattice magnetization.
output_schema: Two lines: first line for R1=0.5 with three comma-separated floats (d_sc1, d_sc2, d_sc3); second line for R1=5.0 with three comma-separated floats (d_s1, d_s2, d_s3).

title: Compute RCP vs applied field
action: Using Monte Carlo simulations, compute the temperature-dependent total magnetization M_t for He = 3, 6, 9, 12 at fixed R2=-1, d_s=0, R1=1. Calculate the magnetic entropy change ΔS_m(T) via the Maxwell relation or finite-difference method, then compute RCP = ΔS_m_max × δT_FWHM. Output RCP for each He.
description: Relative cooling power as a function of reduced external magnetic field.
output_schema: Columns: He (float), RCP (float). One row per He value.

title: Compute RCP vs crystal field
action: For d_s = -15, 0, 15 at fixed R2=-1, R1=1, He=1, repeat the Monte Carlo simulations and compute RCP as in step 3. Output RCP for each d_s.
description: Relative cooling power as a function of reduced crystal field.
output_schema: Columns: d_s (float), RCP (float). One row per d_s value.

title: Compute RCP vs Nd-Mn exchange
action: For R1 = 1.5, 2.5, 3.5 at fixed R2=-1, d_s=-15, He=1, repeat the simulations and compute RCP. Output RCP for each R1.
description: Relative cooling power as a function of reduced Nd-Mn exchange interaction.
output_schema: Columns: R1 (float), RCP (float). One row per R1 value.

title: Compute RCP vs Mn-Mn exchange
action: For R2 = -1.5, -2, -2.5 at fixed R1=1, d_s=0, He=1, repeat the simulations and compute RCP. Output RCP for each R2.
description: Relative cooling power as a function of reduced Mn-Mn exchange interaction.
output_schema: Columns: R2 (float), RCP (float). One row per R2 value.
